requested_sources.label: Google Search Console
requested_sources.requested_export: Performance export for the audited property covering queries, pages, countries, devices, CTR, clicks, impressions, and average position.
requested_sources.why: Search visibility, query fit, CTR, and page-level opportunities cannot be proven from public HTML alone.

requested_sources.label: GA4
requested_sources.requested_export: Landing page, source/medium, conversion, engagement, and AI-assistant referral reports for the same audit window.
requested_sources.why: Public tools cannot verify visits, conversions, or business impact.

requested_sources.label: Bing Webmaster Tools
requested_sources.requested_export: Search performance, crawl/indexing issues, IndexNow status, and AI Performance data if available.
requested_sources.why: Bing/Copilot and IndexNow evidence requires owner access or explicit exports.

requested_sources.label: server logs
requested_sources.requested_export: Bot/user-agent logs for Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Perplexity-User.
requested_sources.why: Crawler access, WAF blocks, and fetch behavior need log evidence.

requested_sources.label: Cloudflare Analytics
requested_sources.requested_export: Traffic, cache, WAF/firewall, bot, and response status analytics for audited URLs.
requested_sources.why: Cache/CDN behavior and blocked crawlers should be verified by owner-side telemetry, not bypass attempts.

cloudflare_policy: Use owner analytics, logs, cache headers, and WAF events. Do not bypass Cloudflare protections.
